result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): A uses a strict 4px token scale throughout, and its filters sit in a tinted strip that is clearly different from the white schedule card. Its horizontal padding is consistent at 16px, although the section header above the list pushes the schedule's top edge below the summary's. B adds working filtering and a summary that updates, but its spacing values are ad hoc (3, 6, 10, 12 and 14px). Its filter bar is styled exactly like the schedule card, so it stands out less as its own group, and padding differs slightly between regions. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): B uses an explicit 4px spacing scale and keeps 16px horizontal insets across the filters, rows and summary, so its edges line up. Its tinted filter strip also sets the filters apart from the schedule card more clearly than A's matching panels. A works better (real filtering and a summary that updates per slot), but its spacing is ad hoc (3/6/10/12/14px) and its summary padding differs slightly from the other regions.
